description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Floor Pan for the Driver’s Side (LH).
Comes Pre-primed in Gray/Brown Primer
Floor Pan size and Cut Pattern are the same for LHD & RHD
Caution: Read Below Statements
Note: This Floor Pan is made for a RHD Samurai but can be modified to fit the LHD Samurai. Affects Seat Tower Bracket & Connection Locations Only. Floor Pan size and Cut Pattern are the same for LHD & RHD
Inspect Pictures and Ask Questions before purchasing because these parts can’t be returned.
Condition Statement: Floor Pans are new sheet metal body parts and as such may have minor dings from shipping via sea freight. All sheet metal body parts must be prepared prior to final painting. This item may also have surface rust.
Special Notice: This part requires the use of welding to be properly installed.
Non-Returnable/ Sale is Final
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Floor Pan (Driver Side – LH)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980-1984 All Models
